QuestInfo.name: The Decision
QuestInfo.0: Maybe #p1032112# is right. The Black Mage is gone, and now you're just a weak, silly Elf... You need to think things over.
QuestInfo.1: You are the sovereign of the Elves! It's YOUR people who are suffering under the Black Mage's Curse! #bYou can't give up now!#k You may be weak, but you'll get stronger. You may not have allies, but you'll make them. Who cares of nobody remembers who you are? Your only duty is to save your people. That's enough!

0.0: He's a crass tree, but maybe he has a point... Perhaps it's time I settle down.
0.1: My battle with the Black Mage is ancient history. Nobody cares about what I did in the past.
0.2: I'm too weak to protect Maple World... Even #o0210100#s give me some trouble. I may even be weaker than the townsfolk...
0.3: And I don't have my old friends to rely on anymore. I'm on my own here. What can I do on my own?
0.4: ...No, that's not right. I'm the sovereign of the Elves! So long as my people are suffering under the Curse of the Black Mage...
0.6: I need to clear my mind.
